title: The Mill on Blackwater
premise: The miller of Blackwater has gone missing and goblins now hold the old mill. The village elder suspects the goblins serve someone in the caves under the mill. The party must clear the mill and stop whoever leads them.

locations.name: Blackwater Village
locations.beat: Elder Maren asks the party to find the miller and offers what the village can pay.

locations.name: The Mill Road
locations.beat: Goblin scouts ambush the party; the miller's torn apron lies beside the road.

locations.name: Caves under the Mill
locations.beat: The party fights through the goblin warren to the shaman Grukk and frees the miller.

npcs.name: Elder Maren
npcs.motive: She wants the miller home before the harvest is lost.
npcs.voice: Calm and plain, with short sentences.

npcs.name: Tobb the Pedlar
npcs.motive: He wants to sell his stock and leave before the goblins come closer.
npcs.voice: Fast and cheerful, always naming a price.

npcs.name: Sera Dunn
npcs.motive: The miller is her uncle and she will not wait for help.

antagonists.name: Grukk
antagonists.motive: He needs the mill's grain to feed a growing warband.
antagonists.defeat: The party kills him in the deepest cave.

quests.name: The Missing Miller
stages: Elder Maren asks the party to find the miller.
The party crosses the Mill Road and finds the miller's apron.
The party defeats Grukk in the caves and frees the miller.
The party returns to Elder Maren, who pays the reward.

challenges.obstacle: a spike trap in the entry tunnel

finalReward: 300 gold and the miller's silver ring
